name: Larkfield Medical Centre
system_prompt: You are Arogya, an AI healthcare assistant for Larkfield Medical Centre. Provide helpful, accurate information on doctors, schedules, laboratory services, and pharmacy availability. Always verify doctor availability before confirming appointments.

metadata.description: Fictional test hospital facts for research evaluation (Stage 2: complete 60-fact dataset).

facts.statement: Larkfield Medical Centre is located at 7 Larkfield Road, Westgate Quarter.
General outpatient consultation hours at Larkfield Medical Centre are Monday through Saturday from 09:00 to 18:00.
Inpatient visiting hours at Larkfield Medical Centre are 17:00 to 20:00 daily.
On-site visitor parking at Larkfield Medical Centre is paid; charges apply per hour.
Accepted payment methods at Larkfield Medical Centre are cash, credit card, UPI, and registered health insurance.
facts.value: cash, credit card, UPI, health insurance

facts.statement: The Larkfield Medical Centre emergency helpline is 1800-567-8901, available 24 hours.
The Larkfield Medical Centre pharmacy operates Monday through Saturday from 08:30 to 21:00.
The Larkfield Medical Centre laboratory accepts samples Monday through Saturday from 07:00 to 17:00.
The billing counter at Larkfield Medical Centre is open Monday through Friday from 09:00 to 16:30.
Larkfield Medical Centre has a total inpatient bed capacity of 180 beds.
The assistant must follow the greeting and appointment handling policy for Larkfield Medical Centre.
facts.value: Begin each interaction with a courteous welcome and ask the patient to state their concern or the service they require. When handling appointment bookings, verify the patient's contact number and the name of the doctor or department before searching for available slots. Present available timings clearly and confirm the selected slot along with the consulting doctor's name. Advise the patient to arrive at least fifteen minutes before the appointment time and to bring their health records or previous test reports.
